stemBlocks: A train consists of a powered engine travelling horizontally pulling two unpowered carriages. The engine has a mass of $20000 \text{ kg}$, and each carriage has a mass of $5000 \text{ kg}$. When the engine accelerates from rest it develops a thrust (driving force) of $15000 \text{ N}$ as shown. Ignoring resistive forces, what is the tension (pulling force) $T$ in the light and inextensible coupling between carriage 1 and carriage 2?
